_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Whether this agent reads its replies aloud, and with which voice.
examples: have this agent speak its answers

value_shape.voice: voice id from the voice catalog

settings.description: Whether people can share their chats with this agent with others.
examples: let people share chats with this agent

settings.description: Whether signed-out visitors may chat with this agent.
examples: let visitors use this agent without signing in

settings.description: Whether members' conversations with this agent are private or reviewable by its operators.
examples: let me review conversations with my agent

settings.description: Whether the agent's working updates appear as separate chat messages while it works: never (none), when it chooses (manual) or always (auto).
examples: show me progress messages while it works
